visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark brown hair and a friendly smile stands outside. She wears a black leather jacket over a white floral top. Behind her is a dark wooden sign for 'LA GRUTA' restaurant, set against a background of lush green trees and foliage in bright natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a massive natural cave. A man in a blue hoodie and black trousers walks down a set of stone stairs leading into the dining area. The cave is filled with dozens of tables, colorful chairs, and warm artificial lighting that highlights the rocky textures. (3) A close-up of the woman inside the cave restaurant. She has changed into a white Mexican-style blouse with vibrant floral embroidery. She looks around the vast space, her eyes wide with wonder at the unique architectural setting and the many diners seated throughout the cavern. (4) A white menu is shown in a close-up insert. Fingers point to various sections, specifically highlighting dishes containing ant larvae and grasshoppers. The text on the menu is clearly visible, listing starters and prices in a formal, printed layout on a table with a white cloth. (5) The woman sits at a table. A dark stone molcajete is placed before her, containing a heap of sautéed ant eggs mixed with green herbs and onions. She stares at the food with a nervous grin, her hands gesturing toward the unusual dish while the man sits beside her. (6) The man in the blue hoodie uses a silver spoon to scoop a generous portion of the ant egg mixture. He feeds it to the woman, who opens her mouth hesitantly. As she chews, her face scrunches up in a humorous grimace, though she continues to eat. (7) A close-up of three green tortillas topped with avocado mash and a large quantity of reddish-brown fried grasshoppers. A lime wedge sits in the center. The woman picks up one of the tortillas, holds it close to the lens to show the insects, and takes a bite. (8) Another man, wearing glasses and a black sweater, is shown sitting at a nearby table in the cave. He takes a large bite of a taco and looks up at the camera with an expression of intense enjoyment, nodding his head to show he likes the food. (9) The camera focuses on a large brown ceramic plate featuring two different 'normal' dishes: grilled chicken strips with peppers and a thick, juicy seared steak. The woman is seen taking a forkful of the steak, her expression shifting to one of pure relief and culinary satisfaction. (10) The woman and the man in the blue hoodie hold a small, lit votive candle between them. They talk softly, looking at the flame and then at each other. The warm candlelight illuminates their faces against the dark, textured backdrop of the cave's stone walls. (11) The woman walks toward a specific section of the rock wall where hundreds of small candles are already flickering. She carefully places her candle on a small ledge. The background is filled with the soft, twinkling glow of the numerous flames against the dark rocks. (12) The woman stands centered in front of the candle-lit wall, raising her arms high in a gesture of celebration. She wears a bright smile. On-screen text 'REBORN' appears in a stylized font, and she does a small celebratory dance as the scene fades.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 吃蟲洞穴餐廳. [Logo]: LA GRUTA. (2) [Subtitle]: 餐廳叫做. [Variety]: ! 注意! 後面會有昆蟲料理! ♫ (3) [Subtitle]: 阿滴要拍的企劃. 我們讓他吃蟲就好. (4) [Subtitle]: (洞穴外面) 太酷了吧. (5) [Subtitle]: 洞穴的氣氛是做得蠻不錯的. (6) [Subtitle]: 他們在上面做菜. (7) [Subtitle]: Emily 說要點. 螞蟻蛋跟這個 grasshopper. (8) [Subtitle]: 但為什麼這麼貴啊. 螞蟻蛋 $677 = 台幣 $1053. (9) [Subtitle]: 美味上菜. 第一個蟲蟲食物來了. 螞蟻蛋. 看起來沒有那麼可怕. (10) [Subtitle]: 不要去想它是什麼東西. 為什麼挖那麼大一口給我. 有難同當. 有福同享. (11) [Subtitle]: 吃起來其實有點像中式炒蛋. 洋蔥的味道. 對 洋蔥炒蛋 很香. 本身也是蛋... 所以. (12) [Subtitle]: 第二道佳餚. 它也太多了吧. 炸蜢玉米餅. (13) [Subtitle]: 玉米餅還是三種不同顏色的. (14) [Subtitle]: (挑最小隻的吃). 吃起來有點像檸檬. (15) [Subtitle]: 一開始進去的味道是鹹的. 吃到最後面會變得非常的酸. 我覺得它卡在我喉嚨裡面. (16) [Subtitle]: 你好有勇氣. You are so brave. 豪豪粗. 墨西哥人表示喜歡. (17) [Subtitle]: 正常的食物來了. 牛排. (18) [Subtitle]: 吃蟲的多有趣. 是啦是啦. (19) [Subtitle]: 是把這個蠟燭拿到後面的那一區. 重生的蠟燭. 對 重生的概念. (20) [Subtitle]: 你是一個嶄新的. 有吃過蟲的. 重生 REBORN. 重生回「沒吃過蟲的」樣子. [Logo]: @crown_du.
